subject: [PATCH v9 28/32] mm: handle PMD swap entries in UFFDIO_MOVE

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch adds support for moving PMD-level swap entries in UFFDIO_MOVE operations. It introduces a new function, move_swap_pmd(), which moves the entry under both PMD locks and propagates soft-dirty flags. The function also handles revalidation of cached folios and anchors their anon rmap to the destination VMA. Additionally, it rejects PMD swap entries at the destination with -EEXIST. This patch addresses an issue where aligned UFFDIO_MOVE operations over swapped-out THPs fail due to missing support for PMD-level swap entries.
